mechanism: Keep one static nonverbal plan strip fully visible in a dedicated zone while a larger execution field changes above it. Advance the execution field in the plan's order through functionally distinct, irreversible states; never edit, reorder or replace the reference strip. Reserve one decisive reveal for the finished-state proof, then hold the actual result together with the unchanged terminal plan cell. The reusable mechanism is persistent-plan verification and ordered execution escalation, not the source chocolate, cake, marble, storyboard artwork, title, twelve-cell layout, utensils, garnish, render style or exact process.

invariants.rule: Establish one complete static plan strip and a separate live execution field at the opening.
invariants.purpose: Makes intended and actual states simultaneously comparable.
invariants.ablation_failure: Showing the plan only once turns it into an intro card.

invariants.rule: Keep the plan strip unchanged and readable while every live state advances in its order.
invariants.purpose: Preserves the plan as a stable verification artifact.
invariants.ablation_failure: Animating or reordering the plan destroys direct comparison.

invariants.rule: Use at least three functionally different execution states with visible irreversible progress.
invariants.purpose: Proves actual work instead of decorative cutting.
invariants.ablation_failure: Repeated close-ups without state change do not execute the plan.

invariants.rule: Reserve one decisive reveal that verifies an internal or completed property.
invariants.purpose: Turns the chain into a payoff rather than a list of operations.
invariants.ablation_failure: A generic beauty shot cannot prove the preceding process succeeded.

invariants.rule: End with the finished result and the unchanged terminal plan cell visible together.
invariants.ablation_failure: Cropping away the plan at the end abandons the verification mechanism.
